g.text: Five original payload types · Held-out test traces (n = 9)
Points/bars: equal-weight trace means and paired trace-bootstrap 95% intervals for each frozen payload type.
Original base/forgery pairs can differ in instruction text or tokenization. These are descriptive readouts, not pure-CoT causal effects.
